lines.en: I trot across the grassland.
I sniff the ground as I go.
I follow the scent all the way.
Sand kicks up under my paws.
I lower my body and creep close.
I patrol this savanna.
I stop and prick my ears.
I head for that herd of grazers.
I'm not fast, but I last.
My clan is waiting up ahead.

lines.zh: 我绕着灌木走，藏住身形
lines.en: I circle the bushes, keeping hidden.
Step by step, I close the distance.
I lie on the hot earth and rest.
I lick my forepaw.
The sun is fierce; I squint.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，闻风里的味道
lines.en: I lift my head and scent the wind.
I hear something in the grass.
The yawn is over, teeth still showing.
My tail sweeps the ground twice.
I'm waiting for it to cool.
My clan is scattered nearby.
I stare at that patch of shade.
I rise slowly, then lie back down.
Insects buzz by my ears.
I've gnawed bones in this spot.
I raise my nose and sniff a long while.
The sun has shifted a little.
No hurry. Prey always moves.
I lick the scraps from between my teeth.

lines.zh: 草在风里一起倒向一边
lines.en: The grass leans all one way in the wind.
You're standing in my hunting ground.
I raise my head, sizing your weight.
You don't run. That interests me.
I take one slow step toward you.
You smell of sweat.

lines.zh: 你手里那东西不太像武器
lines.en: What's in your hand doesn't look like a weapon.
I tilt my head and show my teeth.

lines.zh: 你跑得越远，我追得越快。
lines.en: The farther you run, the faster I go.
Back off, and I'll stop here.
Strangers aren't welcome on this savanna.
I can smell that you fear me.
I laugh, and it sounds like panting.
You are standing on the edge of my hunting ground.

lines.zh: 我们这样对着，谁也不动
lines.en: We face each other, neither moving.
Your sleeve smells of raw meat.
Stay still and I'll stay still.
I recoil with a low growl.
I turn to guard my ribs.
Blood drips onto hot earth.

lines.zh: 这一下让我瘸了一会儿
lines.en: That left me limping for a while.
I shake my head to throw off the pain.
I'll lick this wound and it'll do.
I fall back half a step and stare.
I pant, teeth still bared.
My clan watches from a distance.
One more and I'll leave.
That meat, are you keeping it?
I smell blood.
Throw it and I'll catch it.
Let me sniff first, then decide.
That won't feed a clan.
Put it down and step back.
That smell sets my belly growling.
One bite and it's gone.
Do you have more meat in your pocket?
This is easier than a chase.
I twist aside and avoid you.
You hit my shoulder. It's hard.
I slip past the edge of your boot.
This close, I could bite.
I back off half a step and watch.
My claws scrape your boot.
As we pass, I smell your sweat.
Push me and I push back.
One bump, and I outweigh you.
The ground is churned where we stood.
We live by the clan.
We hunt together or not at all.
You chase that way; I'll cut this off.
I don't mind you tagging along.
The pups eat first.
Keep running. Don't fall behind.
I'll watch your back.

lines.zh: 这一带的气味我都认得
lines.en: I know every scent in this country.
One call and I'll know it's you.
Come back alive; we'll share at dusk.
I snatch it up in my jaws.
I pin it under a paw and sniff.
I can crack that bone.
I carry it a while.
What's dropped is mine.
I dig a shallow hole and bury it.
Too hard. I can't bite through.
Two chews and I swallow.
I'll save it for the pups.
You want some too?
The grass over there just dropped a notch.
I raise my head and fix the direction.
It's strayed from the herd.
I'm judging how fast it runs.
I lower my body, ready.
My clan is circling the other way.
The wind blows my way. Good.
It hasn't scented me yet.
I creep forward.
Close enough now.
I run, faster and faster.
The further off it is, the faster I go.
Near now; I slow my steps.
I stalk low, paws raising no dust.
The farther you are, the faster I run.
It can't match my endurance.
I don't chase past this ground.
My clan has blocked that side.
It can only run for open ground.
I gather myself for the last step.
I leap and bite into it.

lines.zh: 最后一击是最重的一口
lines.en: The last is the heaviest bite.

lines.zh: 我跑得越远越快，靠近了才放慢。
lines.en: The farther I run the faster I go; I slow only up close.
I drag it down.
Bones crack between my teeth.

lines.zh: 这一口带点治伤的东西
lines.en: This bite carries a little healing.
I bite down and whip my head to tear.
My clan closes in.
It isn't moving now.
Time to share it out.

lines.zh: 草原上我先慢走，再冲刺。
lines.en: On the savanna I walk, then sprint.
The wind on the savanna is hot.

lines.zh: 我从沙窝里钻出来，抖毛。
lines.en: I crawl out of the sand hollow and shake my coat.

lines.zh: 沙漠里我跑得最快，最远。
lines.en: Fastest and furthest in the desert.
First I scent the air.
I don't know this ground yet.
I head toward the calls.
I raise my tail, then lower it.
There's prey here, and other things.
I raise my nose and record the scents.
The sun is overhead.

lines.zh: 我开始小跑，沙漠的沙太烫。
lines.en: I break into a trot; the desert sand is hot.
My fur catches fire and I roll on the ground.

lines.zh: 从高处掉下来，我腿一软
lines.en: I fall from a height and my legs give.

lines.zh: 水灌进喉咙，我四爪乱扒。
lines.en: Water fills my throat as all four paws thrash.
The blast flips me onto my back.
Something lodges in my shoulder.
A strange force holds me down.
Days without food; I've gone thin.
Lightning hits; I flatten to the ground.
No ground below; I fall.
